title: Tick Health & Ledger
description: This is a target-state template: every panel is unavailable unless the selected deployment profile advertises the corresponding tick/replay capability and fresh, complete expected-series proof exists. Missing, stale, or unproved series are unknown/unavailable, never healthy. Tick metrics are bounded scope-class rollups (region, game_instance, tenant, or cluster), not individual regions or other raw runtime identities. Use control-plane and structured runtime evidence for exact diagnosis.

panels.title: Tick Status by Scope Class
panels.description: Target-only status signal. Enable only when the selected profile advertises tick-status telemetry and fresh expected-series proof exists; absent, stale, or unproved series are unknown/unavailable, never healthy. The bounded class signal does not identify individual regions.

panels.title: Tick Execution Time Ratio (p99 / mode-specific lock TTL)
panels.description: Target-only mode-aware ratio. Enable only after profile capability and fresh complete execution/TTL series proof; missing, stale, or unproved data is unknown/unavailable, never healthy.

panels.title: Retry and Command Queue Depth
panels.description: Target-only queue-depth diagnostics. Enable only after the selected profile advertises these queue families and fresh expected-series proof exists; absent, stale, or unproved data is unknown/unavailable, never an empty healthy queue.

panels.title: Tick Effect Ledger (Pending/Applied/Abandoned)
panels.description: Target-only ledger diagnostics. Enable only after the selected profile advertises ledger telemetry and fresh expected-series proof exists; missing, stale, or unproved data is unknown/unavailable, never evidence of an empty ledger.

panels.title: Non-RUNNING Scope-Class Status Signals
panels.description: Bounded presence/status signal only: this query shows whether a non-RUNNING class-level status series is present. It does not count individual regions, tenants, or game instances; resolve exact impact from control-plane/runtime-health evidence. Missing, stale, or unproved data is unknown/unavailable.

panels.title: Durable Commit vs Coordination Cleared
panels.description: Target-only durable-commit/coordination-cleared diagnostics. Enable only after profile capability and fresh expected-series proof; absent, stale, or unproved data is unknown/unavailable, never proof of convergence.

panels.title: Tick Cleanup Lag (ms)
panels.description: Target-only cleanup-lag diagnostic. Enable only after profile capability and fresh expected-series proof; absent, stale, or unproved data is unknown/unavailable, never proof of zero lag.

panels.title: Tick Replay Batch Progress
panels.description: Target-only replay-batch progress diagnostic. Enable only after profile capability and fresh expected-series proof; absent, stale, or unproved data is unknown/unavailable, never proof of no replay backlog.

panels.title: Tick Replay Starvation
panels.description: Target-only replay-starvation diagnostic. Enable only after profile capability and fresh expected-series proof; absent, stale, or unproved data is unknown/unavailable, never proof that replay is healthy.

panels.title: Tick Replay Scan Lag (ms)
panels.description: Target-only replay scan-lag diagnostic. Enable only after profile capability and fresh expected-series proof; absent, stale, or unproved data is unknown/unavailable, never proof of low scan lag.
